summary: This is a routine 8-K filed under Item 8.01 (Other Events) by Mobile Infrastructure Corp, reporting that its board authorized and declared monthly dividends on Series A and Series 1 preferred stock. No special-situation event — no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, liquidation, spin-off, rights offering, capital return, delisting, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is described. The filing merely discloses a standard dividend declaration and payment. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation.
